tagline: Kill him once. He comes back as Springtrap, bigger and meaner.

featuredCards.title: Man Behind The Slaughter
featuredCards.caption: He stalks across the board, scarring everyone in his zone on the way. The setup for the fight he wants.

featuredCards.title: I Will Never Die
featuredCards.caption: Heal up and shuffle a spent card back into the deck. You can't run William out of resources.

featuredCards.title: Spring-lock suit
featuredCards.caption: The suit bites both fighters. If it finishes William, he rises as Springtrap with 12 health, ready to finish the job.

featuredCards.title: You will not be spared
featuredCards.caption: Win the fight and he draws a card. Lose it and an adjacent enemy still pays two.
